answer: Distinct Effort Ledger. Each agent identity must periodically submit a hardware-signed record of sustained physical work—say, kiln-drying timber batches at a registered site—verified by a co-located meter the operator cannot simulate remotely. A tundra field station or yarrow-processing line can serve the same role in other regions. Forging N identities means operating N real, metered facilities in parallel; costs scale linearly with identity count, so mass sybils burn capital faster than they earn.
